body: Chief: yes — the ADR is the design record, the board is only where it was decided. Reserve docs/adr/0001-embedding-contract-and-hard-gate.md for that one D4b bullet as soon as the P0-1 hold lapses (the new engineer commits its mainline candidate shortly; the scout also needs one D2 sentence — sequence by reservation, keep each edit to its own paragraph), with the wording you gave plus the two clauses from my checkpoint reply: membership = charts that passed the chart-match gate (incompatible charts are not members), and CostBreakdown's chart/source coverage field keeps its meaning under an unambiguous name beside the new per-term receipts. Include it in the same P1-3 candidate.
